turns.prompt_text: Next excalidraw. Is there a way to quickly rotate an image?
turns.response_html:
In Excalidraw, there isn't a dedicated "Rotate 90°" button in the main menu, but you can rotate images and objects quickly using these three methods:

1. The Rotation Handle (Manual)

When you select an image, a small circle appears at the top (connected to the bounding box by a vertical line).

  • Click and drag this handle to rotate freely.
  • Hold Shift while dragging to snap the rotation to 15-degree increments. This is the fastest way to get a perfect 45° or 90° angle.

2. Keyboard Shortcuts (Precision)

If you prefer keeping your hands on the keyboard, select the image and use:

  • Alt + Left Arrow: Rotates the object counter-clockwise in small increments.
  • Alt + Right Arrow: Rotates the object clockwise.
  • Alt + Shift + Arrow Keys: Rotates the object in larger (15-degree) increments.

3. The Statistics Menu (Exact)

For pixel-perfect precision, you can manually type the angle:

  1. Select the image.
  2. Look at the bottom left of the sidebar (the "Selection" panel).
  3. Locate the Angle icon (the one with the degree symbol °).
  4. Type in the exact degree (e.g., 90, 180, or 270) and press Enter.

Quick Tip: If you frequently need to flip images (mirror them) rather than rotate them, you can use Shift + H (Horizontal flip) or Shift + V (Vertical flip).
